mentions.name: kadaster.club
mentions.description: A map website that displays all land parcel data of the Netherlands, rendering parcels as vectors, staying fast, and showing data even when zoomed out. It also exposes an MCP endpoint (/mcp) so AI agents can query the same parcel data and information from omgevingswet.overheid.nl to answer questions about what is allowed and what permits are needed for a specific location.
mentions.problem: Existing sites for Dutch land parcel data try to upsell users, are slow, don't show parcel data when zoomed out, and don't render the parcel data as vectors.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built https://kadaster.club, which shows all land parcel data of the Netherlands. There's some existing sites for this but they quickly try to upsell you stuff and/or are slow and don't show the parcel data when zoomed out too much. None of the other ones I've seen render the parcel data as vectors either, which hurts my eyes.

I also just added https://kadaster.club/mcp so an agent can query the same data and even look in the data available on https://omgevingswet.overheid.nl/ to answer question around what is allowed and what permits you need for a specific location
mentions.author: bouk

mentions.name: Kadaster.club

mentions.problem: Existing websites for viewing Dutch land registry data are less performant and lack nice vector graphics.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've built this website which shows the land registry data (Kadaster) information of The Netherlands but with nice vector graphics and much more performant than other websites I found: https://kadaster.club
